_comment: PictureBook V3 renderer capabilities per model FAMILY (design section 15). Read through
org.cote.accountmanager.olio.illustration.RendererCapabilities.forModel(checkpointName): families
are tried in order, the first whose glob matches wins, and a name no family matches returns null -
the caller degrades per section 19 rather than guessing. Globs are case-insensitive and are tried
against the full checkpoint name and then its file basename, so a deployment that names
checkpoints 'Flux/flux2Klein_9b.safetensors' still lands on 'flux2*'.
Field names are section 15's, verbatim: maxReferences, supportsReferences, supportsStyleReferences,
supportsInitImage, supportsMasks, supportsRegionalPrompt, supportsSeedReplay, supportsCancel,
supportsBatch, recommendedSteps {low, default, high}, cfgRange [lo, hi], nativeResolutions [[w, h]],
secondsPerStepPerReference. 'enabled: false' means the family is known but refused (Kontext is
retired, section 37; no checkpoint is installed on .39, section 36.1).
Provenance of the seed values:
flux2*   steps 4 is the distilled flux2Klein_9b figure and the shipped flux2Defaults.json value;
24 is a non-distilled flux2 checkpoint (20-28, flux2Defaults.json). cfg 1.0-3.5 is the
edit/reference-model range there ('do NOT use the SDXL cfg'). maxReferences 3 is the
structural left/right/setting count in SceneCompositeUtil. 1024x768 is the classic
pipeline size; 1024x1024 the model's square native.
*xl*     steps 20 and cfg 7 are olio.sd.config's schema defaults (configModel.json); the 5-7 cfg
band is flux2Defaults.json's note; 1024x1024 is SDXL's native (SDUtil mannequin note).
The low/high step figures (12 / 30) are a judgement, not a measurement.
secondsPerStepPerReference is null for EVERY family on purpose. The only timing in the repo
(~40 s per reference at 1024 px / 4 steps, 706 s for 3 references at 24 steps) was measured on the
Strix Halo iGPU, not on the .39 GPU this work targets, and design sections 15 and 18 say estimate
seeds must be measured on .39 before they are shown to anyone. P2-4's live render on .39 is the
first measurement; until then an estimate that needs this value must say it has none.
